title: Locally constant with finitely generated values implies finite type
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme, $\Lambda$ a commutative ring and $\mathcal G$ a sheaf of $\Lambda_Y$-modules on the small etale site $Y_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let $\{u_i:U_i\to Y\}_{i\in I}$ be an etale covering (a jointly surjective family of etale morphisms [def-weil-etale-morphism]) and, for each $i$, $M_i$ a finitely generated $\Lambda$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] together with an isomorphism of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules $\mathcal G|_{U_i}\cong\underline{M_i}$, where $\mathcal G|_{U_i}$ is the restriction to the localised site $Y_{\Et}/U_i=(U_i)_{\Et}$ and $\underline{M_i}$ is the constant sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules with value $M_i$ on $(U_i)_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Then $\mathcal G$ is of finite type [def-weil-pbc-etale-module-finite-type]; more precisely, if $x_{i1},\dots,x_{in_i}$ generate $M_i$, then the global sections of $\mathcal G|_{U_i}$ corresponding to the images of the $x_{ij}$ in $\underline{M_i}(U_i)$ generate $\mathcal G|_{U_i}$ as a $\Lambda_Y|_{U_i}$-module.

source.place: Lemma 093N (lemma-locally-constant-finite-type) (1), the direction 'M finite implies the constant sheaf of finite type' (first sentences of its proof: 'If M is generated by x_1, ..., x_r then x_1, ..., x_r define global sections of the constant sheaf which generate it'), with Lemma 093J (lemma-constant-exact) for the surjection; applied on the members of an etale covering

proof.text: Fix i and a tuple x : Fin n → M_i whose span is top. The displayed sum of projections followed by scalar multiplication is Fintype.linearCombination Λ x, by extensionality and evaluation of the finite sum. Mathlib span_range_eq_top_iff_surjective_fintypeLinearCombination gives its surjectivity, including n = 0. By ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective it is an epimorphism of modules.

The constant presheaf functor preserves epimorphisms componentwise. The sheafification functor preserves epimorphisms as a left adjoint. Their composite constantSheaf therefore preserves the epimorphism in step 1 (Mathlib Functor.map_epi). Compose with the inverse of the supplied isomorphism α_i to obtain exactly the epimorphism of the more-precisely clause. This is the constant-sheaf surjection argument of Stacks 093J; no separate local-surjectivity or abelian-forgetful argument is needed.

For every i, Module.Finite.exists_fin chooses n and x spanning M_i. Use the epimorphism of step 2 as the finite free constant-sheaf presentation on that member of the supplied etale cover. The cover and these presentations witness IsFiniteTypeEtaleModuleSheaf F directly.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 093N (1), finite generators give generators of the constant sheaf, using the constant-sheaf surjection of Lemma 093J; Lean implementation by F2 using Mathlib preservation of epimorphisms.

split_report.summary: Statement kept. Proof in 3 steps following Stacks 093N (1) (its one-sentence argument, with the omitted verification written out): the sections s_ij of G|_{U_i} corresponding to generators x_ij of M_i define phi:(Lambda_Y|_{U_i})^{n_i} -> G|_{U_i}; phi is locally surjective because every section of the constant module sheaf is locally constant (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-constant-module-sheaf-sections-locally-constant, module analogue of the existing ring leaf, CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.instIsLocallySurjectiveToSheafify) and the iso is Lambda-linear; locally surjective implies epi of abelian sheaves (lem-weil-pbc-abelian-sheaf-epi-locally-surjective) and the faithful forgetful functor reflects epis; the definition of finite type (one etale covering of Y) then applies directly. 093J (exactness of the constant sheaf functor) is not needed on this route: the direct local argument replaces the surjection of constant sheaves and avoids the identification Lambda_Y|_U = constant sheaf on U_et and the direct-sum compatibility. Mathlib: the item itself was searched at creation (no constant-sheaf finite-type statement in Mathlib).

lean.statement: theorem locallyConstant_finiteValues_isFiniteType {Y : Scheme.{u}} {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ] (F : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (𝒰 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage Y) (M : 𝒰.I₀ → ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (hfinite : ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀, Module.Finite Λ (M i)) (α : ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀, F.over (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i) ≅ (constantSheaf (Y.smallEtaleTopology.over (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj (M i)) : IsFiniteTypeEtaleModuleSheaf F ∧ ∀ (i : 𝒰.I₀) (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → M i), Submodule.span Λ (Set.range x) = ⊤ → Epi ((constantSheaf (Y.smallEtaleTopology.over (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).map (ModuleCat.ofHom (∑ j : Fin n, (LinearMap.proj j).smulRight (x j) : (Fin n → Λ) →ₗ[Λ] M i)) ≫ (α i).inv)
